text: This is a live recording of Mend, at real speed. A customer reports: A customer's payment was applied to their newest invoice instead of the oldest one.
It rewrites the whole file to change one line, but it had only read part of it.
The full test suite now fails. The rewrite deleted working code, and the worker spends its remaining turns chasing the damage.
Mend's supervisor reads this run back from neatlogs, finds the step that went wrong, and patches its own worker with Claude Code. The patch is kept only because a full re-run got better.
Same task, same model, the repaired worker.
4 turns instead of 15. 17,847 tokens instead of 147,457. Fixed, and proven.
